text:
tasha: Starting canary for gateway-service chart v3.4.0 in ap-south. Deploy bot reported an image pullbackoff for the canary pods (image tag present in eu-west, not pulling here).

deploy-bot: [automated] Deployment event for gateway-service:chart v3.4.0
```
Region: ap-south
Canary: 10%
Pod: gateway-canary-1 -> ImagePullBackOff
Image: registry.internal/gateway:release-3.4.0
Error: manifest unknown: manifest with tag release-3.4.0 not found in region mirror
Registry: https://registry.internal/gateway/manifests/release-3.4.0
```

marc: Looks like the registry mirror in ap-south lags. eu-west canary pulled fine and passed smoke earlier. We need consistent digests for promotion. Options: wait for mirror, patch values to set image.digest to eu-west digest, or rollback. Change window closes in ~20m.

infra-oli: Mirror sync ETA uncertain; working with registry team but could be >1h. For time-critical promos, we normally apply an explicit digest override in the helm values so the cluster pulls the known-good digest. That avoids rollback.

eng-release: Agreed. If manifest layers are identical but manifests differ due to annotations, digest from eu-west is safe. We should record the digest in release notes and pin the release to that digest to avoid automatic reconciles picking the tag again.

tasha: Plan: 1) Read eu-west digest: sha256:cc33d... 2) Annotate release with `deploybot.pin=gateway-service@sha256:cc33d` 3) Apply values override in ap-south: `--set image.digest=sha256:cc33d` via helm upgrade with --reuse-values. 4) Smoke test both regions and update RN. Who can apply the helm override now?

marc: I can run the helm upgrade in ap-south. Will annotate the release first. Command I will run: `kubectl -n releases annotate release gateway-service deploybot.pin=gateway-service@sha256:cc33d --overwrite` then `helm upgrade gateway-service ./charts/gateway --namespace releases --reuse-values --set image.digest=sha256:cc33d --wait --timeout 5m`

deploy-bot: [ack] Received annotation request: deploybot.pin=gateway-service@sha256:cc33d. Pin queued.

infra-oli: Note: create HOTFIX-522 to follow up with registry infra for mirror reliability and consider promoting digest-based promotions as default for cross-region releases.

deploy-bot: [update] Pin job completed at 3667004355. Helm job for ap-south started: job id helm-778.

marc: Helm upgrade finished, image pulled by digest on ap-south nodes, canary at 10%. Smoke: p95 160ms, errors 0.05%. No image pull failures.

eng-release: RN entry created RN-1011: "Promotion paused briefly; pinned image digest across regions due to registry mirror lag. No customer impact." PR: https://git.internal/release-notes/pull/1011

tasha: TL;DR: Applied manual digest override + deploy-bot pin to avoid cross-region manifest skew. Mirror infra ticket HOTFIX-522 opened. We'll unpin after registry confirms mirror convergence.

marc: I'll follow up to remove the pin and revert values once registry signals sync. :white_check_mark:
